setup_logger: initialize a detectron2 logger with optional file output and colored terminal formatting for distributed training
log_first_n: log a message only for the first n occurrences identified by caller or message key
log_every_n: log a message once every n calls from the same caller module
log_every_n_seconds: log a message no more than once every n seconds from the same caller
create_small_table: create a pipe-formatted table string from a small dictionary with keys as headers
